series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

progress.text: The most recent information for the indicator of net GHG emissions and removals is 58,587 kt CO2 eq in 2022. Singapore is on track to meeting our NDC of reducing emissions to around 60 Mt CO2 eq in 2030 after peaking emissions earlier.

target_text.text: Singapore's NDC is an economy-wide absolute emissions limitation target to reduce its GHG emissions to around 60 Mt CO2 eq in 2030 after peaking emissions earlier.

reference_text.text: As Singapore's NDC is an economy-wide absolute GHG emissions limitation target, only the target of around 60 Mt CO2 eq in 2030 will be used as a reference point to track progress towards the implementation and achievement of our NDC. Our NDC does not take reference from any baselines, base years, or starting points.

b.text: As Singapore's NDC is an economy-wide absolute GHG emissions limitation target, only the target of around 60 Mt CO2 eq in 2030 will be used as a reference point to track progress towards the implementation and achievement of our NDC. verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is Second Nationally Determined Contribution, filed 2025-02-10. 50 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (4). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 118.6 MtCO₂e, DS-35 61.2 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 68.5 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 36% reduction in emissions intensity by 2030 compared to 2005 levels, and stabilise its emissions with the aim of peaking around 2030 It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.98°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.41°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
